business_problem: BNP Paribas trade finance operations, especially documentary credit, rely on large volumes of paper documents and manual data handling, creating slower processing, error risk, and compliance challenges in international trade transactions.
solution_summary: BNP Paribas deployed an in-house AI and machine-learning workflow for documentary credit operations in Trade Finance, where large volumes of paper import-export documents previously required manual handling. OCR (optical recognition) acts as the ingestion layer by reading printed, signed, and stamped trade documents and capturing key data fields from documentary credit files. Artificial intelligence and machine-learning steps then automate data identification and capture, speed transaction processing, improve traceability across the stages of import-export operations, and strengthen compliance controls, including anti-money-laundering checks. The resulting outputs support BNP Paribas operations teams and customer-facing trade-finance processes, reducing manual handling errors and giving customers more autonomy. The source does not identify a named storage platform or external technology provider, so the implementation is best understood as an internally operated document-AI pipeline embedded directly into BNP Paribas trade-finance operations and scaled across multiple countries.

solution_components.name: artificial intelligence
solution_components.role: Automates data identification and capture, accelerates operations, and enhances compliance checks in trade finance workflows.

solution_components.name: machine learning
solution_components.role: Supports the streamlined processing and traceability improvements applied to import-export transactions.

data_flow: Printed documentary-credit and other trade-finance documents enter the workflow as OCR inputs. Extracted fields are passed into AI and machine-learning steps that identify and capture data, support compliance and anti-money-laundering checks, and improve traceability during import-export transaction processing before results are used by BNP Paribas operations teams and customer-facing trade-finance workflows.
business_outcome: BNP Paribas reports faster documentary credit processing, improved traceability, stronger compliance and anti-money-laundering checks, fewer manual data-handling errors, and greater customer autonomy, while enabling teams to focus more on customers and correspondent-bank relationships.
